_validation_note: Window broadened from 14 to 21 days per protocol after zero candidates survived the 14-day gate. No additional mechanisms became viable in the 21-day window. Candidate A (Quintillion FWS CD) failed Gate 1 (no independent news outlet covered the FWS notice — only fws.gov itself, a government agency page) and Gate 5 (50 CFR 26.41, fetched from law.cornell.edu, explicitly requires both the Refuge Manager signature AND the Regional Chief concurrence signature — two required signatories, not one; the scout argument that 16 U.S.C. 668dd makes the CD a Refuge Manager-exclusive decision is directly contradicted by the implementing regulation). Candidate B (SBA 8(a) ANC Immunity Stack) failed Gate 4 (neither the Alaska Public Media article (June 12), the ADN article (June 11), nor the KNBA article (June 15) mentions any AI sector consequence, any ANC AI subsidiary, or any direct Alaska AI impact — the connection to Alaska AI is purely inferential) and Gate 7 (the ANC 8(a) Sole-Source Federal Contracting Pipeline was anatomized May 25; the immunity architecture framing covers the same statute (15 U.S.C. 637(a)(13)), the same SBA 8(a) program structure, the same SBA Administrator decision apex, and the same ANC entity-owned exemption — re-mapping the same layer chain under a different analytical frame is prohibited). Candidate C (AETC BOS MAC IDIQ) failed Gate 4 (all 11 work locations confirmed as lower-48 Air Force installations; Alaska AI consequence is inferential ANC capacity-building, not direct) and Gate 5 (no individual Source Selection Authority named in any fetched source). Candidate D (Greensparc SEAPA Stranded-Hydro Edge Data Center) failed Gate 5 (Wrangell Borough Assembly is a multi-member vote body; mayor recommendation is advisory). Candidate E (GCI-Quintillion SCL Transfer) failed Gate 1 (April 22 trigger is 54 days outside 21-day window; SCL-T/C application not yet filed as of June 16). The 21-day broadening did not surface any additional mechanisms. Honest no-target cycle. This is the third consecutive no-target run (June 12, June 15, June 16). The bar was not lowered.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Quintillion Nome-Homer Express FWS Compatibility Determination Stack
dropped_mechanisms.gate_detail: Gate 1 FAIL: The sole trigger URL is fws.gov/story — the mechanism's own agency page. Searches of KTOO, ADN, Alaska Public Media, Alaska Beacon, Alaska Journal of Commerce returned zero independent-outlet articles covering the Quintillion FWS compatibility determination notice within June 2-16. No independent news outlet covered this event in window. Gate 5 FAIL: 50 CFR 26.41, fetched from law.cornell.edu, explicitly requires (1) 'The Refuge Manager's signature and date signed' AND (2) 'The Regional Chief's concurrence signature and date signed.' Two required signatories. The scout argument that 16 U.S.C. 668dd makes the CD a Refuge Manager-exclusive decision is directly contradicted by the implementing regulation at 50 CFR 26.41.

dropped_mechanisms.name: SBA 8(a) ANC Entity-Owned Statutory Immunity Stack

The connection to Alaska AI requires the inferential chain 'ANC subsidiaries include IT firms that do AI work, therefore ANC contracting protections matter for Alaska AI' — this is not a concrete, documentable Alaska AI consequence reducible to sector + decision/risk + named actor + timeframe. Gate 7 FAIL: The ANC 8(a) Sole-Source Federal Contracting Pipeline was anatomized May 25. The immunity architecture framing covers the same statute (15 U.S.C. 637(a)(13)), the same SBA 8(a) program structure, the same SBA Administrator decision apex, and the same ANC entity-owned exemption. Re-mapping the same layer chain is prohibited.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Greensparc SEAPA Stranded-Hydro Edge Data Center Siting Stack
dropped_mechanisms.gate_detail: Gate 5 FAIL: The KSTK meeting agenda (June 10, 2026) confirms the Greensparc item is a public hearing before the full Wrangell Borough Assembly. The Borough Assembly is a multi-member body whose vote is the binding institutional decision. The mayor's stated position is advisory input to the assembly, not a binary institutional decision owned by the mayor under their own authority. Multi-member assembly vote = committee, not chokepoint.
